entries.title: HROT

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: HROT is sourced as a Windows PC release, so the Windows PC version is both the complete and highest-fidelity available route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy HROT on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or alternate edition is documented.
